description:
## What

pkix-lint currently ships exactly one RFC-conformance lint: `Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint`. Once PKIX-9vnx.9.2 implements LintProfile on BasicTlsProfile and BasicSmimeProfile in pkix-profiles, their `lints()` methods would return near-empty Vecs (just the serial-length lint). The resulting `check_basic_tls_shape()` and `check_basic_smime_shape()` would be near-no-op shape-checks -- they'd technically work but wouldn't catch much.

This bead tracks the missing RFC-conformance lints that need to land in pkix-lint to make the BasicTlsProfile / BasicSmimeProfile shape-checks substantive.

## Candidate lints

### For BasicTlsProfile (RFC 5280 + RFC 6125 baseline for TLS server certs)

- RFC 6125 §6.4.1: leaf MUST have subjectAltName extension with at least one dNSName or iPAddress
- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.12 + RFC 6125 §6.4: leaf MUST assert id-kp-serverAuth in ExtendedKeyUsage
- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6: SAN must be present when subject is empty SEQUENCE
- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9: subscriber cert MUST NOT have BasicConstraints.cA=TRUE
- RFC 5280 §4.1: signatureAlgorithm in TBSCertificate matches signatureAlgorithm in outer Certificate

### For BasicSmimeProfile (RFC 8551 §3 baseline + RFC 5280/8398 for S/MIME)

- RFC 8398: leaf MUST have subjectAltName extension with at least one rfc822Name or SmtpUTF8Mailbox otherName
- RFC 5280 §4.2.1.12 + RFC 8551 §3.3: leaf MUST assert id-kp-emailProtection in ExtendedKeyUsage
- RFC 8398 §3: if rfc822Name and SmtpUTF8Mailbox both present for same mailbox, they MUST be equivalent
- (others as discovered during impl)

### Out of scope for this bead

- CA/B Forum-specific lints (those live in pkix-lint-cabf; not RFC-conformance)
- Lints that already exist in pkix-lint-cabf for WebPkiProfile / SmimeProfile / CodeSigningProfile (CABF-side shape checks reference pkix-lint-cabf, not pkix-lint)
- Path-level lints (BasicConstraints chain depth, etc.) -- these are validation concerns, not shape-check concerns

## Acceptance

- [ ] At least one new RFC-conformance Lint impl per candidate above
- [ ] Each Lint has spec_section_id citing its RFC + section
- [ ] BasicTlsProfile::lints() returns these RFC-conformance lints
- [ ] BasicSmimeProfile::lints() returns its RFC-conformance lints (subset overlapping with BasicTlsProfile + S/MIME-specific)
- [ ] Per-lint tests covering pass + fail cases against known cert fixtures
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry in pkix-lint

## Cross-references

- PKIX-9vnx.9.2 (parent: convenience aliases that need these lints to be substantive)
- pkix-lint/src/rfc5280.rs (existing Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint -- the pattern to follow)
- specs/rfc6125.txt (newly added 2026-05-12; needed for dNSName SAN binding)
- specs/rfc8398.txt (newly added 2026-05-12; needed for rfc822Name SAN handling)
- specs/rfc8551.txt (newly added 2026-05-12; needed for emailProtection EKU baseline)
notes: [2026-05-13] PKIX-9vnx.9.2.1.1 closed: 8-of-8 RFC-conformance Lint impls now ship in pkix-lint 0.9.0 (rfc5280, rfc6125, rfc8398, rfc8551 modules). That satisfies acceptance items 1, 2, and 5 ('one new Lint impl per candidate', 'each Lint has spec_section_id', 'per-lint tests'). Acceptance items 3 and 4 (BasicTlsProfile::lints() / BasicSmimeProfile::lints() returning the new lints) remain unmet — those changes live in pkix-profiles and are already in scope under the grandparent PKIX-9vnx.9.2 ('Preconditions: Profile types must implement pkix_lint::LintProfile'). Leaving this bead OPEN until profile-wiring lands; closing PKIX-9vnx.9.2.1.1 alone does not satisfy this bead's full acceptance.
title: Add RFC-conformance lints to pkix-lint so BasicTlsProfile/BasicSmimeProfile shape-checks are substantive
